system.description:
A ship-board fighter who learned to shoot in the chaos of boarding actions — close quarters, multiple targets, no space to reload.

  • Close Quarters: No disadvantage on ranged attacks made in a confined space — ship deck, corridor, or room under 30ft wide.
  • Sea Dog: Advantage on Seamanship checks and on Intimidation checks when visibly armed with firearms.
